note: Made by tools/build_gale_terrain.py from NASA files. See SOURCES.md.

origin.what: Curiosity position, sol 4709, site 120 drive 0 (MMGIS waypoints)

axes: app x = east, app z = minus north, app y = up, metres from the origin

orbital.height_unit: cm above origin, int16 LE, row 0 is the north edge

near.detail_unit: mm, measured minus orbital, feathered, int16 LE

alignment_check.what: Navcam ground minus orbital ground on 1 m blocks that are more than half measured
